<script>

	const date = new Date();
	let day = date.getDate();
	let month = date.getMonth() + 1;
	let year = date.getFullYear();
	var currentDate = `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
	var advertiseCount = 2;
	var promoCount = 0;
	var happeningCount = 1;
	var hidePopup = document.cookie.match('hidefeaturePopupDialog');
	var arrayAdsIndex = [0,1];

	// Get the modal
	var modal = document.getElementById("featuredPopupModal");

	// Get the <span> element that closes the modal
	var span = document.getElementsByClassName("close")[0];

	// When the user clicks on <span> (x), close the modal
	if (span != undefined) {
		span.onclick = function() {
			modal.style.display = "none";
			document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
			if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
				document.getElementById("page").style.overflow = "auto";
				document.getElementById("page").style.position = "relative";
			}
		}
	}

	// Get navigation buttons
	const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prevBtn");
	const nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextBtn");
	const mainModal = document.getElementsByClassName("modal-content")[0];

	// Get all the slides
	const slides = document.getElementsByClassName("featurePopupSlide");

	//hide next & prev btn if there is only one slide
	if (slides.length == 1) {
		prevBtn.style.display = "none";
		nextBtn.style.display = "none";
	}

	// Initialize index to track the current slide
	let currentIndex = 0;

	// Function to show the active slide
	function showSlide(index) {
		if (mainModal) {
			mainModal.classList.remove('advertisement');
		}

		// Hide all slides
		if (slides.length > 0) {

			Array.from(slides).forEach((slide) => {
				slide.classList.remove("active");
			});
			// Show the current slide
			slides[index].classList.add("active");
		}

		if (arrayAdsIndex.length > 0) {
			if (arrayAdsIndex.includes(index)) {
				mainModal.classList.add('advertisement');
			}
		}
	}

	// Show the initial slide
	showSlide(currentIndex);


	// Handle Next Button Click
	if (nextBtn != undefined) {
		nextBtn.onclick = function() {
			currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % slides.length; // Move to next, loop back to start
			showSlide(currentIndex);
		}
	}

	if (prevBtn != undefined) {
		// Handle Previous Button Click
		prevBtn.onclick = function() {
			currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length; // Move to previous, loop back to last
			showSlide(currentIndex);
		}
	}

	jQuery(document).ready(function() {
		changeSection('happening');
		setTranslate();

		if (hidePopup == null && (advertiseCount > 0 || promoCount > 0 || happeningCount > 0)) {

		}

	jQuery('.featurePopupDialogDontShowWrapper .checkboxContainer input').change(function() {
		var date = new Date();

		if (jQuery('.featurePopupDialogDontShowWrapper .checkboxContainer input').prop('checked') == true) {

			});
		} else {
			$.cookie("hidefeaturePopupDialog", "", {
				expires: 0
			});
		}
	})

	function changeSection(value) {
		var happening = document.getElementById('happeningSection');
		var promo = document.getElementById('promoSection');
		var newStore = document.getElementById('newStoreSection');
		var events = document.getElementById('eventSection');
		var kids = document.getElementById('kidsSection');

		$(".btnWhatsOn").each(function(index) {
			$(this).removeClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
		});

		if (value == 'happening') {
			$('#happenBtn').addClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
			happening.style.display = 'block';
			promo.style.display = 'none';
			newStore.style.display = 'none';
			events.style.display = 'none';
			kids.style.display = 'none';
		} else if (value == 'promo') {
			$('#promoBtn').addClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
			selectedPromotionType = 'store_promotions';
			happening.style.display = 'none';
			promo.style.display = 'block';
			newStore.style.display = 'none';
			events.style.display = 'none';
			kids.style.display = 'none';
		} else if (value == 'new') {
			$('#newStoreBtn').addClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
			happening.style.display = 'none';
			promo.style.display = 'none';
			newStore.style.display = 'block';
			events.style.display = 'none';
			kids.style.display = 'none';
		} else if (value == 'events') {
			$('#eventsBtn').addClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
			happening.style.display = 'none';
			promo.style.display = 'none';
			newStore.style.display = 'none';
			events.style.display = 'block';
			kids.style.display = 'none';
		} else if (value == 'kids') {
			selectedPromotionType = 'kids_club_offers';
			$('#kidBtn').addClass('btnWhatsOnSelected');
			happening.style.display = 'none';
			promo.style.display = 'none';
			newStore.style.display = 'none';
			events.style.display = 'none';
			kids.style.display = 'block';
		}

	}

	function goToWhatsOn(value) {
		if (value == "mall-happenings")
			window.location.href = baseUrl + "/whats-on/mall-happenings"
		else if (value == "store-highlights")
			window.location.href = baseUrl + "/whats-on/store-highlights"
		else if (value == "new-stores")
			window.location.href = baseUrl + "/whats-on/new-stores"
		else if (value == "events")
			window.location.href = baseUrl + "/whats-on/events"
		else if (value == "kids-clubs")
			window.location.href = baseUrl + "/whats-on/kids-club-offers"
	}

	$(".selectedPS").click(function() {
		$(".selectedPS").removeClass('selectedPromotionDropdownBtn');

		$(".catBtnPS").html($(this).text());
		$(this).addClass('selectedPromotionDropdownBtn');

		promoCat = $(this).text();

		changeSection($(this).data('promocat'))
	});

	// Util functions
	function map(x, in_min, in_max, out_min, out_max) {
		return (x - in_min) * (out_max - out_min) / (in_max - in_min) + out_min;
	}

	// Scroll image Animation (small Y movement)

	const inners = document.getElementsByClassName('inner');
	let maxTranslate = 80;
	if ($(window).width() < 768)
		maxTranslate = 40;
	const setTranslate = () => {
		Array.prototype.forEach.call(inners, function(item, i) {
			const rect = item.getBoundingClientRect();
			const top = Math.min(0, Math.max(-100,
				(rect.top * 100) / rect.height
			));
			const bot = Math.min(100, Math.max(0,
				((rect.bottom - window.innerHeight) * 100) / rect.height
			));

			let minAbsValue = 0;
			// If bot values are 0 it means the image is inside viewport

			// Always get biggest value
			if (Math.abs(top) > Math.abs(bot)) {
				minAbsValue = top;
			}
			if (Math.abs(bot) > Math.abs(top)) {
				minAbsValue = bot;
			}
			// If image is smaller that viewport
			// Caculate closest percentage.
			// If the image extends to the top and the bot the same height
			// then value will be 0
			if (top != 0 && bot != 0) {
				minAbsValue = top + bot;
			}
			// Then map it to a number between MaxTranslate negative and positive
			const mapped = map(minAbsValue, -100, 100, -maxTranslate, maxTranslate).toFixed(6);
			item.style.transform = `translateY(${mapped*-1}%)`;

		});

	}
	// eEvent lsiteners
	window.addEventListener('scroll', function(e) {
		setTranslate();
	});

	let popupCount = 3;

	var swiper = new Swiper(".swiper", {

	if (popupCount <= 1) {

	// Auto Scroll Animation

			delay: 5000,

		},

		}
	});

		jQuery('#loginForm input').each(function() {
			if (jQuery(this).val() == "") {

				}

	function newsletterUpdateBirthdate() {
		var newsletterYear = $('.newsletterModalWrapper .yearSelection .dropdown-menu li.selected').data('year');
		var newsletterMonth = $('.newsletterModalWrapper .monthSelection .dropdown-menu li.selected').data('month');
		var newsletterDate = $('.newsletterModalWrapper .dateSelection .dropdown-menu li.selected').data('date');


		$('.newsletterModalWrapper input[name="newsletter_birthdate"]').val(newsletterYear + '-' + twoDigitNum(newsletterMonth) + '-' + newsletterDate);

	function newsletterGetDayInMonth() {
		var newsletterSelectedMonth = $('.newsletterModalWrapper .monthSelection .selectionDropdown li.selected').data('month');
		var newsletterSelectedYear = $('.newsletterModalWrapper .yearSelection .selectionDropdown li.selected').text();

		var newsletterDaysInmonth = new Date(newsletterSelectedYear, newsletterSelectedMonth, 0).getDate();

		var newsletterDaySelection = '';

		for (i = 1; i <= newsletterDaysInmonth; i++) {
			if ($('.newsletterModalWrapper .dateSelection .selectedDate').text() == i) {
				newsletterDaySelection = newsletterDaySelection + '<li data-date="' + twoDigitNum(i) + '" class="selected">' + twoDigitNum(i) + '</li>';
			} else {
				newsletterDaySelection = newsletterDaySelection + '<li data-date="' + twoDigitNum(i) + '">' + twoDigitNum(i) + '</li>';
			}
		}

		$('.newsletterModalWrapper .dateSelection .selectionDropdown').html(newsletterDaySelection);
	}

	function daysInMonth(month, year) {
